focus: 越級升級卡住的跨團隊依賴
lead: 今天練的是把別人團隊造成的阻塞往上升級：你已經催了三週、對方沒動，而你有一個硬期限。心法 —— 帶著紀錄、帶著日期、帶著一個要對方做的決定，但不要把它變成告狀。每個 speaking 段落請先出聲講完再看 model answer。

phrases.en: I'm escalating this because I've run out of room to solve it at my level.
phrases.gl: 我升級，是因為在我這一層已經沒有解法了（一開口就說明升級的理由，聽起來是判斷，不是抱怨）
phrases.ex: I'm escalating this because I've run out of room to solve it at my level — the storage quota needs an approval I can't give myself.

phrases.en: Here's the trail, so you can see it's not a fresh ask.
phrases.gl: 這是往來紀錄，證明這不是臨時才提（用事實鋪路，比說「我催很久了」有力）
phrases.ex: Here's the trail, so you can see it's not a fresh ask: I raised it on the 6th, followed up on the 13th and the 20th, and there's still no owner on the ticket.

phrases.en: The point of no return is the 5th.
phrases.gl: 不可逆的時間點是幾號（把模糊的「很急」換成一個具體的懸崖邊緣）
phrases.ex: The point of no return is the 5th — after that, ingest starts dropping bags and we can't re-collect those runs before the review.

phrases.en: To be clear, nobody dropped the ball. Two priorities collided.
phrases.gl: 先澄清這不是誰失職，是優先順序撞在一起（讓對方願意解問題，而不是先自保）
phrases.ex: To be clear, nobody dropped the ball. Two priorities collided — Kevin's team is mid-migration and my collection ramp landed in the same three weeks.

phrases.en: I'm not asking you to referee. I'm asking for a priority call.
phrases.gl: 我不是要你評理，我是要你排優先順序（把升級的性質講清楚，對方就不用選邊站）
phrases.ex: I'm not asking you to referee between two teams. I'm asking for a priority call: does the quota extension go ahead of the migration this week, or not?

phrases.en: I've tried three things already. Here's what's left.
phrases.gl: 我已經試過三件事，剩下的是這些（證明升級是最後一步，不是第一步）
phrases.ex: I've tried three things already — a ticket, a direct ask to Kevin, and compressing the night set. Here's what's left, and both options need someone above me.

phrases.en: If nothing changes by Friday, here's what happens automatically.
phrases.gl: 如果週五前沒變化，這件事會自動長成什麼樣（用「預設結果」製造決策壓力，而不是用情緒）
phrases.ex: If nothing changes by Friday, here's what happens automatically: I stop two of the four vehicles on Monday to stretch the storage, and we lose eight collection slots before the review.

phrases.en: This is a priority conflict, not a technical problem.
phrases.gl: 這是優先順序衝突，不是技術問題（點名問題的真正類別，才會找對的人解）
phrases.ex: This is a priority conflict, not a technical problem — the quota change itself takes about an hour of Kevin's team's time.
phrases.fix: 取代 “The platform team is not cooperating with us”

phrases.en: Could you make the call today, or point me to who can?
phrases.gl: 你今天能決定嗎？不行的話請告訴我誰可以（把請求收成一個是非題，並留一條路給對方）
phrases.ex: Could you make the call today, or point me to who can? I just need it settled before the vehicle slots get released tomorrow.
phrases.fix: 取代 “Please kindly help to push the platform team ASAP”

setup: Setup. Your raw data storage sits at 480 TB of a 500 TB budget, and the four collection vehicles ingest about 14 TB a day, so you hit the ceiling around the 5th — after which ingest silently drops bags instead of failing loudly. You asked Kevin's platform team for a quota extension on the 6th and followed up on the 13th and the 20th; the ticket is still unassigned because his team is two people short and in the middle of a cluster migration. The alternative is deleting 90 TB of unlabeled March rosbags, which needs Ivy's sign-off on the governance side and may still be wanted by Grace's evaluation team. Meanwhile you need twelve more vehicle slots before the milestone review on the 8th to close the cut-in recall gap, so stopping collection is expensive. This morning you have fifteen minutes with Rachel, the director two levels up, and David, your program manager, knows you are taking it to her.

prompts.q: You open your fifteen minutes with Rachel. She knows nothing about the storage situation.
prompts.frame: Say why you're escalating → the hard date and what breaks → the trail in one line → what you've already tried → the single decision you want from her.
prompts.say: 先出聲講完整段（目標 45 秒），不要從技術背景講起，也不要先提 Kevin 的名字。
prompts.model: “Rachel, I'm escalating this because I've run out of room to solve it at my level. We're at 480 of our 500 TB storage budget and we ingest about 14 a day, so the point of no return is the 5th. After that, ingest starts dropping bags quietly — we'd only find out weeks later when the training set comes up short. Here's the trail so you can see it's not a fresh ask: quota request on the 6th, follow-ups on the 13th and the 20th, still no owner on the ticket. I've tried three things already — the ticket, a direct ask, and compressing the night set, which bought us four days. What's left needs someone above me: either the quota goes up by 200 TB, or we delete the 90 TB of unlabeled March bags. Both need a call today.”

prompts.q: Rachel: “Have you actually talked to Kevin about this? I don't love going over people's heads.”
prompts.frame: Confirm you went direct, with specifics → defuse the blame reading explicitly → name the real category of the problem → say why it can't be resolved peer-to-peer → hand the decision back.
prompts.say: 出聲練習「越級但不告狀」——語氣要平，不要有委屈感，30 秒內講完。
prompts.model: “Yes — twice directly, on the 13th and again last Thursday, and he was straight with me both times. To be clear, nobody dropped the ball here. Two priorities collided: his team is two people down and mid-migration, and my collection ramp landed in the same three weeks. So this is a priority conflict, not a technical problem — the quota change itself is maybe an hour of his team's time. Kevin and I can't settle it between us because neither of us owns the trade-off. That's why it's in front of you. I'm not asking you to referee. I'm asking for a priority call: does this hour jump the migration queue this week, or do we go the deletion route instead?”

prompts.q: Kevin joins the call, a little defensive: “We've had it in the queue. My team is down two people and we're mid-migration — I can't just reshuffle everything because your dates moved.”
prompts.frame: Take the pressure off him first → agree with his constraint out loud → shrink the ask to something specific and small → put the default consequence on the table without threatening → close on one question with a deadline.
prompts.say: 出聲講一次「對方防禦時怎麼降溫又不放掉期限」——不要收回你的期限，但要把要求縮小。
prompts.model: “Kevin, that's fair, and my dates did move — that part's on my side, not yours. I'm not asking you to reshuffle the migration. What I actually need is narrower than the ticket makes it look: a 200 TB bump on one bucket, which I think is about an hour, and I'll do the tagging cleanup myself so nothing else lands on your team. If that hour genuinely doesn't exist this week, say so and I'll stop asking — I'll take the deletion route and go get Ivy's sign-off instead, but that path takes four days, so I'd need to start it tomorrow morning. And if nothing changes by Friday, here's what happens automatically: I park two vehicles on Monday to stretch the storage, and we lose eight collection slots before the review. So one question, and I'll take either answer — can your team give me that hour before Tuesday?”

fixes.bad: I have already discuss about this issue with Kevin two times.
fixes.good: I've already raised this with Kevin twice.
fixes.note: Verb form + “discuss about”：have 後面要用過去分詞 discussed；discuss 是及物動詞，後面直接接受詞，永遠不加 about。會議裡 raise 比 discuss 更有「我主動提出」的味道。

fixes.bad: Most of people in the platform team don't know about this deadline.
fixes.good: Most of the people on the platform team don't know about this deadline.
fixes.note: Quantifier + preposition：most of 後面要接限定的名詞（most of the people），泛指時直接說 most people；「在某個團隊裡」英文用 on the team，不用 in the team。

fixes.bad: If the quota will not be extended, we will lose the data.
fixes.good: If the quota isn't extended, we'll start losing data.
fixes.note: Conditional tense：if 子句用現在式表未來，不放 will；主要子句才用 will。data 這裡是泛指，不加 the。

fixes.bad: I don't have enough informations to make the decision now.
fixes.good: I don't have enough information to make the call right now.
fixes.note: Uncountable noun：information 不可數，沒有 informations，也不加 an；口語中決定常說 make the call，比 make the decision 更像會議語言。

fixes.bad: I explained already to Rachel the risk of the storage.
fixes.good: I already explained the storage risk to Rachel.
fixes.note: Word order：already 放在主要動詞前面（already explained）；英文動詞後先接直接受詞再接 to + 人，不要把人插在中間。另外 the risk of the storage 太繞，直接說 the storage risk。

challenge:
今天在真實會議或訊息中做這一件事：挑一個你已經催過兩次以上、對方沒動的依賴，用這個順序把它升級 ——

“I'm escalating this because I've run out of room to solve it at my level. The point of no return is ___. Here's the trail: ___. To be clear, nobody dropped the ball — this is a priority conflict. Could you make the call today, or point me to who can?”

錄音作業（60 秒，手機錄）：用英文練習一次越級升級，對象設定成你主管的主管。

  • 前 15 秒之內必須出現「不可逆的日期」和那天會壞掉的東西
  • 必須講出你已經自己試過的三件事，一句話帶過即可
  • 必須有一句幫對方團隊解套的話（nobody dropped the ball 或 two priorities collided）
  • 結尾必須是一個今天就能回答的是非題，不能是 please kindly help to push
  • 禁用：discuss about、informations、ASAP、任何帶情緒的 always / never（例如 they never reply）
check: 我升級的時候，有沒有先講清楚「為什麼這件事必須到你這一層」，而不是一開口就講對方沒做事？
我有沒有給出一個不可逆的日期，以及那天之後會自動發生什麼？
面對對方防禦時，我有沒有把要求縮小到一個具體、很小的動作，同時沒有把期限往後讓？
